title: Quiz Config
description: Metadata and question-content path for an independent quiz.

id.description: Unique kebab-case quiz identifier, usually matching its folder name.

description.description: Short description of the quiz and what it covers.

questions.description: Path to the QuizContent JSON array, relative to the quiz folder.

time-limit-seconds.description: Optional time limit in seconds. Omit to allow unlimited time.

shuffle-questions.description: Whether to randomize the order of questions for each attempt.

shuffle-answers.description: Whether to randomize answer options for each question.

show-results-immediately.description: Whether to show the quiz result immediately after submission.

allow-retake.description: Whether learners may attempt the quiz again after submitting.

show-explanations.description: Whether to show question explanations with the result.
